title: Inpage Navigation / Basic / Grid
summary: Flexible grid layout for displaying basic category nodes on entry pages with customizable alignment and headings.
features: Multiple color modes: on-light, on-dark, on-bright
Three alignment options: left, center, and auto spacing
Optional header, subline, and show more link
Support for flagged category nodes with promotional badges
longDescription:
## Purpose

The InpageNavigationBasicGrid component provides a flexible grid layout for displaying category nodes on entry pages, helping guide shoppers into relevant product categories. It serves as a primary navigation aid especially on homepages and landing pages.

## Use Cases

- Display category overview grids on store entry pages and homepages
- Highlight sale categories with dedicated styling and promotional flags
- Add contextual headings and sublines to describe the category section
- Include a "show more" link to direct users to complete category listings
- Apply promotional badges to individual category nodes within the grid

## Design Rationale

The grid layout offers three alignment modes to accommodate different design aesthetics: left-aligned for traditional layouts, center-aligned for balanced presentations, and auto for even node spacing. The component integrates seamlessly with CategoryNodeBasic components and supports the full range of promotional flags for highlighting time-sensitive or featured categories.
shortDescription: Guides users into product categories on homepages and landing pages. Show more link renders as an additional node at the end of the grid. Integrates with CategoryNodeBasic components and LuiText for typography. Responsive breakpoint handling adapts layout for mobile and desktop viewports.
